title: Campus Director
html:
Campuses: Vancouver, BC
Location: Onsite, Vancouver Campus
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Reporting to: Vice President/ Dean and CEO

Pay: $75,000 – $80,000 annually, additional Performance Bonus

About InFocus:

InFocus Film School is an independent film school built on the premise of providing an accelerated education in film and entertainment arts. Originally founded as a non-profit society in 2010, InFocus has become Vancouver’s top cinematic arts training institution, offering diploma and certificate programs in film production, 3D animation, visual effects, screenwriting, and digital graphic design. While our structure has changed over the years, the growth of emerging artists, storytellers, and the arts and entertainment industry as a whole has remained at the core of everything we do. As our organization grows, we are seeking an experienced and mission-driven leader to step into the role of Campus Director.

Position Overview:

The Campus Director provides strategic and operational leadership to the Vancouver, BC Campus. Reporting directly to the Vice President, this role is responsible for the overall performance, compliance, and culture of the college’s campus operations. The Campus Director oversees all designated programs, manages a team of Program Coordinators, and ensures that infocus continues to deliver an exceptional student experience in alignment with PTIRU requirements and institutional standards.

This is a senior leadership position that requires both a strong post-secondary education background and a demonstrated ability to lead teams across multiple locations. The successful candidate will bring a deep understanding of the private career college environment in Canada and a commitment to academic integrity, regulatory compliance, and student success.

Key Responsibilities

Campus Operations & Multi-Site Leadership

  • Oversee day-to-day operations at the InFocus campus, ensuring consistent standards, policies and service delivery across all locations.
  • Serve as the senior operational leader on campus, maintaining a visible and engaged presence across all sites as required.
  • Develop and implement operational procedures to improve efficiency, consistency, and the overall student and staff experience.
  • Manage campus facilities in coordination with relevant internal and external stakeholders to ensure safe, compliant, and well-maintained learning environments.

Team Leadership & Program Coordination

  • Directly manage and mentor a team of Program Coordinators, providing clear direction, regular performance feedback, and professional development support.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and student-centred team culture across all campuses.
  • Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and performance management of campus-level instructional and administrative staff in partnership with HR.
  • Conduct regular team meetings and one-on-one check-ins to ensure alignment with institutional goals and program delivery expectations.

Academic Program Oversight

  • Provide oversight for all programs designated under the PTIRU, ensuring delivery standards are met and maintained.
  • Collaborate with Program Coordinators and instructors to monitor student outcomes, completion rates, and program satisfaction.
  • Support curriculum review processes and recommend program improvements in response to labour market trends and regulatory expectations.
  • Ensure that program scheduling, practicum coordination, and instructional resources are managed effectively at each campus.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the Private Training Institutions Regulatory Unit (PTIRU), Private Vocational Training Regulation, and all applicable Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills requirements.
  • Ensure campus operations remain in full compliance with PTIRU designation conditions, including annual reporting obligations, student contract requirements, and complaint resolution processes.
  • Liaise with the VP/Dean and the administrative team in preparation for regulatory inspections, audits, and any compliance action responses.
  • Maintain accurate and organized campus-level records in accordance with PTIRU requirements and institutional policy.

Student Experience & Success

  • Champion a student-centred culture across all campuses, ensuring students receive timely, respectful, and effective support throughout their enrolment.
  • Oversee the implementation of student support services, including orientation, academic advising referrals, and complaint resolution processes.
  • Monitor student satisfaction and engagement data, and lead initiatives to address identified gaps or concerns.
  • Act as an escalation point for student concerns that cannot be resolved at the Program Coordinator level.

Curriculum Oversight & Academic Quality

  • Provide oversight of curriculum design, structure, and implementation across all InFocus programs, ensuring content meets designation requirements and industry standards.
  • Support the development and alignment of program-level learning outcomes, working collaboratively with Program Coordinators and instructional staff.
  • Guide curriculum review and continuous improvement processes, incorporating student outcome data, graduate feedback, and labour market trends.
  • Contribute to the integration of theoretical and clinical or practicum components within applicable programs, ensuring coherent and well-sequenced learning experiences.
  • Support faculty in course development and instructional approaches where needed, connecting them with appropriate resources and professional development opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Reporting

  • Contribute to InFocus’ institutional strategic planning, providing operational insights and campus-level data to support decision-making.
  • Prepare and present regular reports to the VP/Dean on campus performance, enrolment trends, staff capacity, and operational priorities.
  • Identify opportunities for program growth, campus improvement, and enhanced community partnerships.
  • Support the implementation of institutional initiatives, policy changes, and quality improvement plans.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education

  • Master’s degree from a recognized Canadian institution or an equivalent credential that has been assessed and verified through World Education Services (WES) or an equivalent designated credential evaluation body recognized in Canada. (Required)
  • Degrees in Education, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field are considered an asset.

Experience

  • A minimum of one (1) year of direct leadership experience within a private career college in Canada. (Required)
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-disciplinary teams, including performance management, coaching, and team development.
  • Hands-on experience with private vocational training operations, including familiarity with designation, licensing, compliance, student contracts, and program delivery.
  • Experience working across multiple campuses or locations is considered a significant asset.
  • Background in admissions, student services, or academic program coordination is an asset.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong working knowledge of the Private Training Institutions Regulatory Unit (PTIRU) and British Columbia’s private career college regulatory landscape.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with an approach that builds strong and lasting relationships.
  • Detail-oriented with strong creative problem-solving, organizational, and time management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Proven ability to implement change and drive innovation within an educational setting.

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

InFocus Film School is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and lived experiences, including Indigenous Peoples, racialized persons, persons with disabilities, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

title: Student Finance Support
html:
InFocus Film School
Vancouver, BC
Onsite | Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Some weekends as needed

Pay: $45,000.00 per year

About the Role

InFocus Film School is looking for a Student Finance Planner to join our team in Vancouver. This is a student-facing, onsite role focused on helping students move through the financial planning and funding process with confidence, clarity, and strong follow-through.

The Student Finance Planner supports students from early financial conversations through loan application completion, required documentation, funding follow-up, and enrolment readiness. This role is ideal for someone who is organized, service-driven, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple files in a fast-paced environment.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct Financial Entrance Interviews with students
  • Complete financial planning and budget sheets with students during the interview process
  • Meet with students to complete and submit loan applications within 48 hours of Appointment 1
  • Prepare and submit appendices, schedules, and program information forms within 24 hours of the loan application
  • Prepare student loan disbursement agreements and ensure documents are signed through PandaDoc (or similar) within 24 hours of the loan application
  • Support students with MSFAA completion
  • Monitor loan approval status and follow up as needed
  • Maintain weekly follow-up and engagement with active students
  • Complete and update enrolment requirements in student records
  • Create agreements for new enrolments to the pending stage within 48 hours of enrolment conversion
  • Review reports daily to prioritize tasks and ensure records are current
  • Proactively maintain file compliance, spot check file completion, and ensure statuses are accurate
  • Post payments in systems, where appropriate, based on internal segregation of duties
  • Participate in daily huddles to report priorities, goals, and trends
  • Work closely with admissions, finance, and student services to support a strong student experience
  • Follow-up and collect on outstanding tuition
  • Complete financial exit interviews

What We Are Looking For

  • Post-secondary education in business, administration, finance, student services, or a related field is preferred
  • Experience in student finance, administration, admissions, financial aid, or student support is an asset
  • Strong administrative, organizational, and time management skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines
  • Ability to work with sensitive and confidential student information
  • Comfortable using digital systems, e-signature tools, and student information platforms
  • A student-first mindset with a professional and supportive approach

Compensation

Base salary is $45,000 per year, with a monthly performance bonus tied to service levels, compliance, and file completion. Total expected annual earnings are approximately $60,000 based on achievement of performance targets.

Working Conditions

  • Onsite role in Vancouver
  • Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
  • Some weekend work may be required based on student needs and peak periods

InFocus Film School acknowledges that our campus is located on the traditional, ancestral, and unceded territories of the xʷməθkʷəyəm (Musqueam), Sḵwxwú7mesh (Squamish), and səlilwətaɬ (Tsleil-Waututh) Nations. We recognize and respect the enduring relationship that Indigenous Peoples have with these lands and remain committed to learning, listening, and contributing to a more respectful and inclusive future.

title: Graphic Design Instructor
html:

Onsite | Monday to Friday | 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM EST

This role is ideal for someone with strong graphic design experience, a passion for teaching, and the ability to create a positive and professional virtual classroom environment.

  • Work with academic leadership to ensure course quality, consistency, and student success

title: Admissions Advisor
html:
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Schedule: Standard business hours, with occasional evening or weekend coverage during peak periods

Location: Vancouver, BC | Delivery: Onsite

Compensation: CA $40,000 – CA $45,000 annually, plus performance bonus

About InFocus Film School:

InFocus Film School is an independent film school in the heart of historic Gastown, Vancouver, committed to nurturing the next generation of filmmakers, storytellers, and industry leaders. Through fully hands-on, project-based education, students develop creative autonomy and graduate with the skills and portfolio to launch real careers.

Located in one of the world’s most active film production hubs, we also offer industry-specific training courses for various roles in film and TV production. Our campus is a collaborative environment where innovation and creativity thrive, and our team reflects those same values.

About the Role:

We are looking for a motivated, people-focused Admissions Advisor to join our Vancouver team. In this role, you will be one of the first voices prospective students hear, and one of the most meaningful relationships they have as they explore a career in film, television, animation, or VFX.

You will guide leads through every step of the admissions process, from first inquiry through to enrolment, building genuine connections and helping prospective students match their ambitions to the right program. This is a performance-driven role with real earning potential, structured training, and room to grow within a creative, student-centered organization.

What You Will Do

  • Respond to prospective student inquiries by phone, email, text, and video in a timely, professional, and personable manner
  • Build genuine rapport with leads and guide them through each step of the admissions process, from first contact through to enrolment
  • Conduct admissions consultations and interviews, evaluate program fit, and help prospective students connect their goals to the right InFocus program
  • Provide clear, accurate, and complete information about programs, schedules, tuition, and the student experience
  • Follow up consistently and proactively to move applications forward and meet enrolment targets
  • Support students with application steps, required documents, and next actions
  • Maintain accurate notes, statuses, and activity in internal systems
  • Work closely with finance, student services, and leadership to support enrolment goals
  • Participate in daily team huddles, coaching sessions, and ongoing training
  • Support open houses, information sessions, and recruitment events (occasionally evenings or weekends, approximately 4 to 6 times per year)
  • Represent InFocus Film School with professionalism, energy, and genuine care for the students we serve

What We Are Looking For

  • Post-secondary diploma or degree required.
  • Minimum 1 year of experience in Admissions and Student Recruitment within a Private Career College is required.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a student inquiry pipeline, follow up consistently, and meet enrollment targets.
  • High level of ambition, initiative, and professional work ethic.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to confidently engage prospective students by phone, video, email, and in person.
  • Ability to receive coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve performance.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple applicants, deadlines, and administrative tasks simultaneously.
  • Genuine interest in film, television, VFX, or animation. Industry experience is not required, but enthusiasm for the creative sector is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with the private post-secondary education landscape in British Columbia is an asset.
  • Bilingual or multilingual abilities are considered a strong asset.
  • Must be available to work onsite in Vancouver, BC, Monday to Friday.

Working Conditions

  • Onsite role in Vancouver
  • Monday to Friday schedule, with some evenings and weekends as needed
  • Fast-paced, student-facing environment
  • Training provided

InFocus Film School is a creative, entrepreneurial, and student-focused learning environment. We are looking for team members who want to grow, contribute, and help students take the next step toward their future.
